verdict.rationale: Framer documents a Server API and a native external-agent connection that can read, write and delete CMS items, so credential scoping is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence describes issuing API keys or tokens with restricted scopes, permissions or least-privilege limits for an agent. Auto-branching of agent changes and password protection are adjacent safety controls, not scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
